title: Congressional Hearing Adds Fuel to Flock Fire
summary: EPIC recaps a Senate Judiciary subcommittee hearing on Flock Safety's nationwide ALPR network, highlighting testimony from privacy experts, an Arizona sheriff who canceled a Flock contract, a woman wrongfully jailed after a false Flock match, and a cybersecurity expert who described flaws in Flock cameras.

key_quotes.quote: Flock's vehicle fingerprinting algorithm uses computer vision to catalogue make, model, color, license plate, and unique features such as bumper stickers and bike racks.
The hearing also featured a woman who was imprisoned after her vehicle was falsely flagged by Flock in a car crash investigation.
EPIC has long opposed the unchecked expansion of ALPRs and recently filed an amicus brief arguing that Flock's warrantless dragnet mass surveillance is unconstitutional.
